name: Ahmed Raza
comment: Bohot acha hostel hai. WiFi fast hai, khana bhi milta hai. Staff bohot helpful hai. Highly recommended!

name: Fatima Khan
comment: Best co-living experience ever! Study room is amazing, community is great. Mujhe yahan sab kuch pasand aya.

name: Usman Ali
comment: Luxury suite at great price. Near NUST, AC, attached bath sab hai. Thoda expensive hai lekin worth it.

name: Sana Malik
comment: Budget ke liye best option. Clean hai, secure hai. Meals bhi miltay hain. Students ke liye best choice.

name: Hassan Mirza
comment: Library aur cafe ne study game change kar di. Community events bhi hote hain. 100% recommend!

name: Ayesha Siddiqui
comment: Girls ke liye sabse safe hostel in Islamabad. Lady warden 24/7 available, CCTV har jagah. Parents bhi khush hain!
